question: Where is the Manikaran Geothermal Energy Plant located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Manikaran Geothermal Energy Plant:**

__
 
• It is **located in the Parvati Valley of Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• It is** situated at an altitude of 1760 meters** above sea level and is **one of the highest geothermal energy plants in the world**.
 
• The plant has a **capacity of generating 3.5 MW of electricity **and also provides hot water for bathing in the nearby hot springs.
 
• The geothermal energy at Manikaran is derived from the hot water springs that are found in the region due to the proximity of the Himalayan mountain range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The major **power plants in Punjab **are:

 
• Talwandi Sabo Power Limited.
 
• Goindwal Sahib Thermal Power Plant.
 
• Guru Gobind Singh Plant.
 
• Rajpura Thermal Power Plant.
 
• Nabha Power Limited.

The major** power plants in Jammu and Kashmir** are:

 
• Baglihar Power Project.
 
• Ratle Hydroelectric Plant.
 
• Dul hasti Hydroelectric Plant.

The major **power plants in West Bengal** are:

 
• Mejia Thermal Power Station.
 
• Farakka Super Thermal Power Station.
 
• Kolaghat Thermal Power Station.
 
• Sagardighi Thermal Power Station.
 
• Bakreshwar Thermal Power Station.
